purpose: Raw/source-normalized snapshots used to build AvtoCena Knowledge CORE. These files are evidence inputs, not public catalog truth by themselves.

rules.photos: Store only source image URLs when an openly usable, model-bound image exists. Photos are optional during CORE denominator collection.

sources.license: CC-BY-4.0; preserve VehiclesDB and upstream attribution
sources.notes: Global denominator spine. Current manifest 2026.08.2 reports 277 car makes and 4,895 car models. Bulk CSV is retained because it is easier to deterministically compile than display-oriented JSON. Do not treat it as a substitute for market-specific power/spec sources.

sources.license: EEA public data; preserve source/attribution metadata
sources.notes: Snapshot unique technical tuples, not millions of duplicate registration rows. Final status is preferred; 2025 is provisional until final data exists.
DOE/EPA bulk CSV is preferred over per-vehicle API loops. It covers Ford, Chevrolet, GMC, Cadillac, Jeep, RAM, Tesla and other US-market vehicles alongside imports.
vPIC is manufacturer-submitted identity evidence for vehicles intended for US sale/import. Broad make/model calls are snapshotted; avoid high-rate per-VIN requests.
Official NRCan CSVs supplement North-American identity/spec coverage and include dedicated BEV/PHEV files through 2026.

sources.license: PRC government public information; retain source URL and batch provenance
sources.notes: MIIT/EIDC states the free system exposes vehicle technical parameters from announcement batch 173 onward and PDF parameter pages. The public browser uses doCpQuery POST for product lists; use that intended query contract at low rate. Never bypass slider/CAPTCHA on technical detail pages. Live doCpQuery verification on 2026-08-22 found batches 328-408 queryable; declared batches 409 and 410 returned missing-table responses, so they are not counted as failed data collection. The bounded enterprise-name query is supplemental regulatory evidence; AutoHome remains the broad China model/variant denominator.

collectionQuery.scope: bounded public-query evidence; not an exhaustive copy of every MIIT product row

sources.notes: Used only as a structured Chinese market identity/spec corroboration and gap-fill layer behind official/regulatory evidence. Collection is series-level and deliberately low-rate: one brand index, one public brand page per brand, and one config page per discovered series; no anti-bot bypass or per-listing scraping.

sources.license: Japan MLIT public information; retain source URL/date
sources.notes: Crawl MLIT annual indexes and preserve source provenance. Prefer directly published XLS/XLSX/CSV tables; PDF text extraction is a fallback for older tables and uses pdftotext rather than OCR. Binary files are hashed and converted to JSON/text rather than committed as repository ballast.

sources.license: Korean Public Data Portal: unrestricted use on dataset page
sources.notes: 424,332-row Jeju registration extract is downloadable without login. The downloader prefers the live official file and retains its source hash/row count, but commits only distinct 2020+ technical/name tuples with observation counts because duplicate registrations add no vehicle-knowledge value. A hash-gated compact fallback is preserved from successful same-branch workflow run 32557200820 for periods when data.go.kr is unreachable from GitHub runners; its workflow artifact, raw source hash, chunk hashes and reconciled counts are all recorded.

sources.license: Korea Energy Agency public information service; downstream reuse terms require review
sources.notes: Official Korea Energy Agency live model catalog queried without login for release years 2020-present. It complements Jeju registration names with manufacturer, class, fuel, transmission, efficiency, range, emissions, release year and test-number evidence.

sources.license: Korean Public Data Portal: unrestricted use
sources.notes: Free/auto-approved API key is required by the portal. Snapshot metadata now; do not fabricate nationwide rows without an authorized key.
Every production knowledge-gap report is part of the denominator. Source marketplace facts require verification before becoming authoritative CORE facts.
